speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling
text: asked the Minister for Health for advanced stage-4 or terminal cancer patients who will not be able to complete their treatments with non-Cancer Drug List (CDL) drugs by 30 September 2023, whether the Ministry will consider enabling them to tap on a higher MediSave amount to alleviate their financial worries.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: I am just following up on the matter of appeals with regard to this subject.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: I have a resident who is in a similar predicament and I can imagine there are others.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: Does the Senior Minister of State have any indications on how many appeals have been forwarded to MOH for consideration, for cases where the drugs are not on the CDL anymore?

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: Perhaps Mr Singh might like to file a separate question on that.

speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling (Ang Mo Kio)
text: I just wanted to ask two supplementary questions.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: There are a variety of mechanisms that we can use to try to find the best way to assist.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: I would encourage the Member to reach out, including to reach out to me, if necessary.
